Name: Seasonal HD Wallpapers
Author: peachsmile
Description:
[size=6][b]Seasonal HD Wallpapers[/b][/size]
[size=4]Seasonal wide-format HD wallpapers with rain and snow on the wallpaper[/size]
[b]This is a seasonal, wide-format HD wallpaper mod that can display rain and snow on your wallpapers. The wallpaper artwork comes from AI-generated images and free assets, and the code was written by AI.[/b]
It adds a custom wallpaper framework and a content pack with 71 HD wallpapers. Vanilla wallpapers are only 16 px wide and repeat across the wall; this mod draws any-width textures tile by tile, so a single wide artwork can fill a whole wall.

[b][size=5]Features[/size][/b]
[b]71 HD wallpapers[/b] — 1–9 are seasonal (spring / summer / fall / winter switch automatically); 10–71 are fixed.
[b]Any width[/b] — choose stretch-to-fill or repeat when the wall is wider than the wallpaper; wallpapers wider than the wall are never scaled.
[b]Weather on wallpapers[/b] — rain and snow are drawn over wallpapers; thunderstorms are denser and more slanted, green rain turns green, rainy days can dim the wallpaper.
[b]In-game settings (GMCM)[/b] — stretch mode, weather toggle, rain density / speed / size / slant / brightness, snow density / speed / size / brightness, rainy dimming (10 options).
[b]Localized UI[/b] — settings follow the game language (English / Chinese).

[b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0+
Content Patcher
Generic Mod Config Menu (optional; otherwise edit config.json)

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
Install SMAPI and Content Patcher.
(Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu.
Drop the [b]Seasonal HD Wallpapers (Framework)[/b] and [b]Seasonal HD Wallpapers (Content Pack)[/b] folders into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/b].
Launch the game.
Manual installation is recommended; the archive contains one framework folder and one content pack folder.

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
All options are in GMCM under [i]Seasonal HD Wallpapers (Framework)[/i], or in [b]Seasonal HD Wallpapers (Framework)/config.json[/b]:
Stretch wide wallpapers (on/off)
Wallpaper weather effects (on/off)
Rain density / speed / size / slant / brightness
Snow density / speed / size / brightness
Rainy wallpaper dimming

[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Unique IDs (Lead.SeasonalWallpapers, Lead.SeasonalWallpapersContent); no conflicts with other mods.
Does not modify game files or write to saves.
Harmony postfixes only; can coexist with other wallpaper, weather and retexture mods.
Wallpaper numbers may change between versions; wallpapers already applied in rooms may need to be re-picked.
Please do not reupload without permission.

[b][size=5]Credits & AI disclosure[/size][/b]
Wallpaper art: AI-generated images and free assets.
Code: written with AI assistance.
Built with SMAPI, Content Patcher and Generic Mod Config Menu.
[i]AI disclosure: this mod contains AI-generated artwork and AI-assisted code. Please mark the AI content option in the upload wizard.[/i]
[center]— — —[/center]


[size=6][b]季节性高清壁纸[/b][/size]
[size=4]能显示雨雪的季节性宽幅高清壁纸[/size]
[b]这是一个能显示雨雪的季节性宽幅高清壁纸模组。壁纸素材来自 AI 绘制与免费素材，代码由 AI 完成。[/b]
模组由自定义壁纸框架 + 内容包组成，共 71 张高清壁纸。原版壁纸只有 16 像素宽、靠平铺填满墙面；本模组可以按格绘制任意宽度的贴图，让整张宽幅画铺满一面墙。

[size=5][b]功能[/b][/size]
[b]71 张高清壁纸[/b]：1–9 号是季节壁纸（春/夏/秋/冬自动切换），10–71 号固定。
[b]任意宽度[/b]：墙比壁纸宽时可选拉伸铺满或循环平铺；壁纸比墙宽时不缩放。
[b]壁纸天气[/b]：下雨/下雪时在壁纸上叠雨丝和雪花；雷雨更密更斜，绿雨变绿，雨天可压暗壁纸。
[b]游戏内设置（GMCM）[/b]：拉伸模式、天气开关、雨丝密度/速度/大小/倾斜/亮度、雪花密度/速度/大小/亮度、雨天变暗，共 10 项。
[b]中英文界面[/b]：设置项名称和提示随游戏语言切换。

[size=5][b]前置需求[/b][/size]
星露谷物语 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0+
Content Patcher
Generic Mod Config Menu（可选，没有就改 config.json）

[size=5][b]安装[/b][/size]
安装 SMAPI 和 Content Patcher。
（可选）安装 Generic Mod Config Menu。
把 [b]Seasonal HD Wallpapers (Framework)[/b] 和 [b]Seasonal HD Wallpapers (Content Pack)[/b] 两个文件夹放进 Stardew Valley/Mods/。
启动游戏。
建议手动安装：压缩包里是一个框架 + 一个内容包。

[size=5][b]设置[/b][/size]
都在 GMCM 的 Seasonal HD Wallpapers (Framework) 页面，或改 config.json：
壁纸拉伸填满（开/关）
壁纸天气效果（开/关）
雨丝密度 / 速度 / 大小 / 倾斜 / 亮度
雪花密度 / 速度 / 大小 / 亮度
雨天壁纸变暗

[size=5][b]兼容性[/b][/size]
独立 UniqueID，不与其他模组冲突。
不修改游戏文件、不写入存档。
只用 Harmony postfix，可与其他壁纸/天气/美化模组共存。
壁纸编号可能随版本变化，已贴的壁纸可能需要重新选择。
未经允许请勿转载。

[size=5][b]致谢与 AI 声明[/b][/size]
壁纸素材：AI 绘制与免费素材
代码：在 AI 协助下完成
使用 SMAPI、Content Patcher、Generic Mod Config Menu

[i]AI 声明：本模组包含 AI 生成的图像和 AI 协助编写的代码，上传时请勾选相应 AI 内容选项。[/i]
